name: openbb_dividends
description:
Dividend history for one stock through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.fundamental.dividends).
Returns: {symbol, dividends: [records with ex_dividend_date, amount and, depending on the provider, record, payment and declaration dates]}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; provider (fmp, intrinio, nasdaq or yfinance; default yfinance, no key).
Other sources: yf_dividends; upcoming market-wide: openbb_equity_calendar_dividend. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "KO", "provider": "yfinance"}
